meaning: Open pressure switch, 2nd stage: PS2 is open when it should be closed.
causes: Obstructed pressure switch hose or flue piping, or incorrect vent size
diySteps: Check outdoor vent and intake terminations for blockage
Technician: check PS hose, flue piping and vent size
Technician: check inducer and pressure switch
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: if terminations are clear and the code persists.
